rationale: C12 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template for the child's assistance provision. Its section 3 has nearly the same sequence and language: agencies represented on the body furnish assistance, pursuant to section 214 of the May 3, 1945 act; assistance may include detailing employees; one may serve as executive officer; and those employees perform functions assigned by the body consistent with the order's purposes. C03 contains essentially the same machinery and is a strong alternative, while C11 additionally parallels the designation of the Department of Labor to provide space and facilities. C12 is strongest because its wording and operative sequence most closely match the child and it immediately precedes it in time.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Consonant with law, the Department of Labor and the Department of Commerce shall, as may be necessary for the effectuation of the purposes of this order, furnish assistance to the Committee in accordance with section 214 of the act of May 3, 1945, 59 Stat. 134 (31 U.S.C. 691).
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Consonant with law, each agency represented on the Board shall, as may be necessary for the effectuation of the purpose of this order, furnish assistance to the Board in accordance with section 214 of the act of May 3, 1945, 59 Stat. 134 (31 U.S.C. 691).
shared_material.explanation: Near-verbatim assistance clause with the same statutory authority and only the responsible agencies and institutional label changed.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Such assistance may include detailing employees to the Committee, one of whom may serve as executive officer of the Committee, to perform such functions, consistent with the purposes of this order, as the Committee may assign to them
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Such assistance may include detailing employees to the Board, one of whom may serve as Executive Officer, to perform such functions, consistent with the purpose of this order, as the Board may assign to them.
shared_material.explanation: The personnel-detailing mechanism, executive-officer role, qualification, and assignment authority follow the same distinctive sequence and language.
